@settingsAgentsEmpty.description: The one row under On this Mac when no agent was found on this Mac and none has reported.

@settingsAgentsConnect.description: Link in the empty On this Mac row; it opens the README's section on connecting an agent.

@settingsAgentInstall.description: Button that adds adhd-todo's MCP server to an agent.

@settingsAgentInstalling.description: Shown in place of the Install MCP button while it runs.

@settingsAgentInstalled.description: At the right of an agent that already has adhd-todo's MCP server. A check mark comes before it.

@settingsAgentGet.description: Link to the website of an agent that is not on this Mac.

@a11yInstallMCP.description: Accessibility label of the Install MCP button of an agent.

@a11yGetAgent.description: Accessibility label of the Get it link of an agent.

settingsAgentsCommand: Or run this once in a terminal, for Claude Code

@settingsAgentsCommand.description: Line above the command that installs the MCP into Claude Code, at the bottom of Settings > Agents.

@settingsAgentOther.description: Label of the row at the bottom of Settings > Agents for an agent that is not in the list.

settingsAgentOtherBody: Not in the list? Copy this guide and paste it to the agent: it adds adhd-todo itself.

@settingsAgentOtherBody.description: Second line of the Another agent row in Settings > Agents.

@settingsCopyGuide.description: Button that copies the guide an agent follows to add adhd-todo's MCP server to itself; also its accessibility label.

settingsAgentNoCore: adhd-core isn't at {path}. Build it first, then try again.

@settingsAgentNoCore.description: Why Install MCP did nothing: the adhd-core program the agent would run is missing.

@settingsAgentGone.description: Why Install MCP did nothing: the agent's command is gone.

settingsAgentTimeout: {agent} took too long to answer. Try again.

@settingsAgentTimeout.description: Why Install MCP did nothing: the agent's command did not finish in time.

@settingsAgentFailed.description: Why Install MCP failed: the last line the agent's own command printed.

settingsAgentManual: {file} isn't plain JSON, so adhd-todo won't rewrite it. Add this to it:

@settingsAgentManual.description: Shown under the agents when a config file cannot be edited safely (a JSON file with comments, or a Cordis patch that is not a list); the snippet to add follows in a box.

@settingsAgentCannot.description: Why Install MCP failed, for a reason with no sentence of its own.

@composerModelLabel.description: Accessibility label of the model chip at the bottom right of the composer: the model in use.

@composerModelTitle.description: Heading of the popover that lists the configured models, opened from the model chip.

@composerModelNone.description: Line of the model popover when no provider is configured (it is not normally reachable).

@composerAttach.description: Accessibility label and tooltip of the + button of the composer, which opens a file panel for images.

@composerAttachTitle.description: Title of the file panel that opens from the + button of the composer.

@composerPictureRemove.description: Accessibility label of the x on the thumbnail of an attached image.

@composerPicture.description: Accessibility label of the thumbnail of an attached image.

composerPictureLimit: At most 4 images at a time.

@composerPictureLimit.description: Quiet line under the composer when a fifth image is added.

composerPictureFormat: That file isn't a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.

@composerPictureFormat.description: Quiet line under the composer when a dropped, pasted or chosen file cannot be read as an image (a HEIC photo, a PDF).

composerPictureSize: That image is too large, even shrunk.

@composerPictureSize.description: Quiet line under the composer when an image is still over 5 MB after it was shrunk.

@composerPictureUnreadable.description: Quiet line under the composer when a dropped file cannot be opened.

@composerPictureDrop.description: Hint inside the composer while image files are dragged over it.

@problemNoImages.description: Assistant error: pictures were sent to a model that does not take them. The model chip opens next, to pick another.

@navMine.description: Sidebar row and page title of the home screen: what is mine to do, and what agents handed over.

@navAgents.description: Sidebar row and page title of the screen that shows what agents are doing.

@categoryWork.description: Name of the work category: the sidebar row under Mine, that page's title and a choice of the Category property.

@categoryLife.description: Name of the life category: the sidebar row under Mine, that page's title and a choice of the Category property.

@categoryUnsorted.description: Sidebar row under Mine and title of its page: the tasks nobody classified as work or life.

@sectionFromAgents.description: Section of Mine: what agents handed over to the user.

@sectionToday.description: Section of Mine: the user's tasks due or reminded today, and the ones in progress.

@sectionLater.description: Section of Mine: the user's tasks of the next days, then the ones with no date.

@sectionWorking.description: Section of Agents: tasks the agents are working on.

@agentsWorking.description: Quiet text beside the title of Agents: how many tasks are being worked on.

@subtasksCount.description: Quiet text of a finished task on Agents: how many subtasks it had.

@pillDone.description: Pill of a subtask that is finished.

@pillDoing.description: Pill of a subtask that is being worked on.

@pillHandedBack.description: Pill of a subtask whose agent handed its work back to the main agent for review.

needAgentDone: {agent} finished and is waiting for you

@needAgentDone.description: Second line of an agent task that is done and waits for the user.

@needAgentStuck.description: Second line of a blocked agent task; words is what the agent said it needs.

needAgentStuckPlain: {agent} is stuck and waits for you

@needAgentStuckPlain.description: Second line of a blocked agent task with nothing more to say.

@actionAnswer.description: Button of a row where an agent waits for an answer.

@actionReview.description: Button of a row where an agent finished and waits for a look.

@propParent.description: Label of the inspector row of a subtask: the task it belongs to.

@inspectorSubtasks.description: Header of the list of subtasks in the inspector of a task.

a11yMineUnseen: {count, plural, one {# new from your agents} other {# new from your agents}}

@a11yMineUnseen.description: Accessibility label of the red badge beside Mine in the sidebar.

composerPlaceholderAgents: Ask what your agents are doing

@composerPlaceholderAgents.description: Placeholder of the composer on Agents.

@agentsEmpty.description: Title of the Agents screen when nothing is being worked on.

agentsEmptyBody: When an agent reports its progress, it shows up here.

@agentsEmptyBody.description: Quiet line under the title of the empty Agents screen.

@menuOpenIn.description: Item of the task menu of an agent's task, and the title of its page: opens where the agent works in the agent's app, a terminal, an editor or Finder.

@openWithAgentApp.description: Choice of where to open an agent's work: the desktop app of the agent that handed the task over. Also in the Open in page of the task menu.

@openWithTerminal.description: Choice of where to open an agent's work: a terminal at the folder the agent works in.

@openWithEditor.description: Choice of where to open an agent's work: a code editor (Cursor, Visual Studio Code or Zed) on the folder the agent works in.

@openWithFinder.description: Choice of where to open an agent's work: the folder the agent works in, shown in Finder.

@settingsOpenWith.description: Label of the setting in Settings > Agents that says where Review and Answer on a handed-over row take the user.

settingsOpenWithBody: Brings the agent's app forward. It cannot open the exact session.

@settingsOpenWithBody.description: Quiet line under the Open agent work in setting: what opening the agent's app can and cannot do.

@rowOpenFailed.description: Quiet error line under a handed-over row when opening the agent's work failed. The reason is the system's own words.

rowOpenNoFolder: Nothing to open: the agent did not say where it works.

@rowOpenNoFolder.description: Quiet error line under a handed-over row when there is no folder to open in a terminal, an editor or Finder.

rowOpenNoEditor: No editor found. Install Cursor, Visual Studio Code or Zed.

@rowOpenNoEditor.description: Quiet error line under a handed-over row when none of the supported editors is installed.

@calendarDayCount.description: Quiet text beside the date in the header of the calendar's day card: how many items the day has.

@calendarDayPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the input at the foot of the calendar's day card; what is typed becomes a task due that day.

@calendarDayInput.description: Accessibility label of the input at the foot of the calendar's day card.

@a11yCalendarDayCard.description: Accessibility label of the calendar's day card; day is the day in words, as in "Fri, Oct 16".

@a11yCalendarShowAll.description: Accessibility label of the "N more" line of a calendar day, which opens the day card; day is the month and day, as in "Oct 15".

@a11yCalendarAddTo.description: Accessibility label of the + that shows in a calendar day while the pointer is over it; day is the month and day, as in "Oct 15".

@a11yCalendarDayClose.description: Tooltip and accessibility label of the close button of the calendar's day card.

@calendarDayTitle.description: Title of the calendar's day card: the full weekday, the month as calendarMonthShort says, and the day number.

listMineEmpty: Nothing for you here — write one above

@listMineEmpty.description: Quiet line in the Mine column of a project that has tasks but none of yours.

listAgentsEmpty: No agent has reported in this project yet

@listAgentsEmpty.description: Quiet line in the Agents column of a project where no agent has reported.

@listInstallMCP.description: Link after the empty Agents column's line; opens Settings > Agents.

@listWaiting.description: Group in the Agents column of a project: tasks the user handed to an agent that has not reported on them yet.

listWaitingHint: Tell any agent “do #{id}” to pick it up

@listWaitingHint.description: Second line of a row waiting for an agent: how to have an agent pick it up. id is the task number.

listDropToHand: Drop to hand to an agent

@listDropToHand.description: First line of the Agents column while a task of the user is dragged over it.

@handOffDone.description: Toast after a task was handed over. Nothing is started; the task waits for any agent.

@handOffTakenBack.description: Toast after an agent's task was dragged back to the Mine column.

@imagesAdd.description: The quiet line in the inspector of a task with no images; it opens the file panel.

@imagesAddTile.description: Accessibility label of the dashed + tile after the images of a task in the inspector.

@imageOpen.description: Accessibility label of the thumbnail of an image of a task; a click opens it in the viewer.

@imageDetach.description: Tooltip and accessibility label of the x on an image tile in the inspector.

@imageDetached.description: Toast after an image was taken off a task, with Undo.

@viewerPosition.description: The bar under the image in the viewer: its name, its place among the task's images and its size in pixels.

@viewerOpenInPreview.description: Button in the viewer's bar that opens the image file in macOS Preview.

@viewerClose.description: Accessibility label and tooltip of the x of the image viewer.

@viewerPrevious.description: Accessibility label and tooltip of the left chevron of the image viewer.

@viewerNext.description: Accessibility label and tooltip of the right chevron of the image viewer.

@viewerImage.description: Accessibility label of the image shown in the viewer.

receiptImages: {n, plural, one{with its image} other{with its images}}

@receiptImages.description: Part of the line after the assistant added or changed a task: the task kept the pictures sent with the request.

@navSummary.description: Sidebar item and title of the page that shows what was finished in a day or a week.

@summarySegmentDay.description: Segment on the Summary page: the day.

@summarySegmentWeek.description: Segment on the Summary page: the week.

@summaryPrevious.description: Label and tooltip of the button that goes back a day or a week on the Summary page.

@summaryNext.description: Label and tooltip of the button that goes forward a day or a week on the Summary page. It stops at today.

@summaryWeekRange.description: The week the Summary page shows, between the paging buttons.

@summaryDayOfMonth.description: The last day of a week that ends in the same month it starts in, after the first day: the 19 of "Oct 13 – 19".

@summaryExport.description: Button on the Summary page that opens the Markdown of the day or the week.

@summaryWritten.description: Small header of the assistant's paragraph on the Summary page.

@summaryRewrite.description: Link that makes the assistant write the paragraph of the Summary page again.

summaryRewriteNew: More was finished since this was written

@summaryRewriteNew.description: Tooltip of the dot beside Rewrite on the Summary page.

@summaryFailed.description: Quiet line in the place of the assistant's paragraph when writing it failed.

@summaryEmptyToday.description: Line in the place of the paragraph on the Summary page when nothing was finished today.

@summaryEmptyDay.description: Same, for a day that is over.

@summaryEmptyWeek.description: Same, for the week that is not over.

@summaryEmptyPastWeek.description: Same, for a week that is over.

@summaryShippedToday.description: Label of the total at the foot of the ledger, for today.

@summaryShippedDay.description: Same, for a day that is over.

@summaryShippedWeek.description: Same, for the week that is not over.

@summaryShippedPastWeek.description: Same, for a week that is over.

summaryMerged: {count, plural, one {# PR merged} other {# PRs merged}}

@summaryMerged.description: In a row of the ledger: how many of the person's finished tasks went in as a merged pull request.

@summaryUnit.description: The unit after the count of finished tasks in a row of the ledger.

@summaryRowMerged.description: In a task of the ledger: its pull request merged.

@summaryA11yRow.description: Accessibility label of a row of the ledger on the Summary page, which opens to that person's tasks.

summaryA11yScene: The shipping scene. Click the sky to play it again.

@summaryA11yScene.description: Accessibility label of the pixel scene on the Summary page.

@summaryExportTitle.description: Title of the sheet that shows the Markdown of the day or the week.

@summaryExportCopy.description: Button of the export sheet that copies the Markdown.

@summaryExportCopied.description: The Copy button for a moment after it copied.

@summaryExportSave.description: Button of the export sheet that saves the Markdown as a file.

@summaryExportClose.description: Button of the export sheet that closes it.

@summaryMdDay.description: Title of the exported Markdown of a day.

@summaryMdWeek.description: Title of the exported Markdown of a week.

@summaryMdParen.description: After a task title in the exported Markdown: its project and pull request.

@summaryMdSaid.description: After a task in the exported Markdown: what the agent's last report said.

said.example: Board, lists and inspector are in

@summaryMdOpen.description: Last line of the exported Markdown: what is still open.

@summaryOpenProgress.description: Part of the still-open line: tasks an agent is working on.

@summaryOpenReview.description: Part of the still-open line: tasks waiting for the user's review.

@summaryOpenBlocked.description: Part of the still-open line: tasks an agent is stuck on.

@settingsEndOfDay.description: Label of the switch for the end-of-day reminder in Settings > General > Notifications.

settingsEndOfDayMeta: Weekdays: today's summary, and the weekly one on Friday

@settingsEndOfDayMeta.description: Quiet line under the end-of-day reminder switch.

settingsEndOfDaySwitch: Remind me at the end of the day

@settingsEndOfDaySwitch.description: Accessibility label of the end-of-day reminder switch.

@settingsEndOfDayTime.description: Label of the pop-up that sets when the end-of-day reminder comes.

@notifyWeekDoneTitle.description: Title of the end-of-day notification on Friday, which is about the week.

@notifyDayDoneBody.description: Body of the end-of-day notification when no pull request merged today.

notifyDayDoneBodyPRs: {count} finished today, {merged, plural, one {# PR} other {# PRs}} merged. See today's shipping?

@notifyDayDoneBodyPRs.description: Body of the end-of-day notification when pull requests merged today.

notifyWeekDoneBody: This week: {count} finished. The weekly summary is ready.

@notifyWeekDoneBody.description: Body of the end-of-day notification on Friday.

notifyDayNothingBody: That's it for today. See you tomorrow.

@notifyDayNothingBody.description: Body of the end-of-day notification on a day nothing was finished.

@selectButton.description: Button at the right of a page title that turns on select mode, where a click ticks a row instead of opening it.

@a11ySelectButton.description: Accessibility label of the Select button beside a page title.

@selectCount.description: Quiet text in the title row while the page is in select mode: how many rows are ticked.

@selectAll.description: Link in the title row of select mode that ticks every row of the page.

bulkDoneToast: Marked {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} done

@bulkDoneToast.description: Toast after Done was chosen for the rows selected together; its Undo puts them back. count is how many tasks changed.

bulkCancelToast: Cancelled {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}

@bulkCancelToast.description: Toast after the rows selected together were cancelled; its Undo puts them back.

bulkMoveToast: Moved {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} to {where}

@bulkMoveToast.description: Toast after the rows selected together were moved to a project or the Inbox; its Undo moves them back. where is the project's name, or Inbox.

bulkPriorityToast: Set {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} to {priority}

@bulkPriorityToast.description: Toast after a priority was chosen for the rows selected together; its Undo puts the old priorities back. priority is P0 to P3.

bulkDeleteToast: Deleted {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}

@bulkDeleteToast.description: Toast after the rows selected together were deleted; its Undo puts them back with their reports.

bulkDeleteTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}?

@bulkDeleteTitle.description: Title of the sheet that asks before the rows selected together are deleted.

bulkDeleteBody: Their progress reports go with them.

@bulkDeleteBody.description: Body of the sheet that asks before the rows selected together are deleted.

@handOffMany.description: Toast after several tasks were handed over, by the bulk bar or by dragging a stack of rows to the Agents tray. Nothing is started; the tasks wait for an agent.

@handOffManySkipped.description: Toast after tasks were handed over when some of the selected ones could not be: only the user's own unfinished tasks can be. skipped is how many were left out.

handOffNone: Only your own unfinished tasks can be handed to an agent

@handOffNone.description: Toast when Hand to an agent was chosen and none of the selected rows could be handed over.

@a11yBulkBar.description: Accessibility label of the toolbar that floats at the bottom of a list while several tasks are selected.

@bulkCount.description: Count at the left of the bulk bar: how many tasks are selected.

@bulkHandOff.description: Button of the bulk bar and item of the selection's task menu that hands the selected tasks to any agent. Nothing is started.

@bulkClear.description: Accessibility label and tooltip of the × at the right of the bulk bar, which unselects every row.

@bulkCancel.description: Item of the selection's task menu that cancels the selected tasks (status Cancelled), as opposed to dismissing the menu.

@bulkMarkDone.description: Item of the selection's task menu that marks the selected tasks done.

@bulkDeleteMenu.description: Item of the selection's task menu that deletes the selected tasks, after a question. count is how many.

@menuManyHeader.description: Quiet header at the top of the task menu opened on several selected rows: how many tasks it acts on.

listDropToHandMany: Drop to hand to an agent ({count})

@listDropToHandMany.description: First line of the Agents tray while a stack of several of the user's rows is dragged over it; the stack is handed over together. count is how many rows are carried.

@handOffCopy.description: Button of the hand-off toast. It puts a sentence on the clipboard to paste into an agent so it picks up the handed tasks, such as: Do adhd-todo task #12.

@handOffCopied.description: What the Copy for the agent button of the hand-off toast reads for a moment after it was clicked.
